create_QConfigMultiMapping: create a QConfigMultiMapping to store multiple QConfigs for each QConfig matching style
set_global_qconfigs: set global default QConfigs on a QConfigMultiMapping using a list of QConfigAny objects
set_object_type_qconfigs: set QConfigs for a given module type or function using set_object_type on a QConfigMultiMapping
set_module_name_regex_qconfigs: set QConfigs for modules matching a regex pattern using set_module_name_regex
from_list_qconfig_mapping: create a QConfigMultiMapping from a list of existing QConfigMapping objects
